nodes.description: mintPrice (0.069 ether) required for paid mints; writable via adjustPrice
Constant MAX_MINTS = 2000 total supply cap checked in mint paths
Constant MAX_CDB_MINTS = 250 free-mint cap for CryptoDickbutt holders
mapping(uint=>bool) cdb_mint tracking CryptoDickbutt ids already claimed for a free mint
mapping(uint=>uint) tokenHash storing the generated hash per token id
Counters.Counter counter_mints counting paid mints
Counters.Counter counter_cdbs counting free CryptoDickbutt mints
ICryptoDickbutts cdb external contract handle (addr_cdb 0x42069...)
generationCodeHash public string holding the minified p5 code hash
mapping(uint=>string) generationCode on-chain javascript storage, owner writable
_baseURIextended private string used by _baseURI for token metadata
_paused bool from Pausable guarding mint entry points
mint() payable whenNotPaused: charges mintPrice, increments counter_mints, stores hash, _safeMint to msg.sender
mintWithCDB(uint cdbID) whenNotPaused: free mint for CryptoDickbutt holder, writes cdb_mint, increments counter_cdbs, _safeMint
reserveMints() onlyOwner: loop of 10 reserved mints before any public mint occurs
withdraw() onlyOwner: transfers whole contract balance to msg.sender
adjustPrice(uint new_price) onlyOwner: updates mintPrice
generateHash(uint inp) internal view: keccak256 over block.difficulty, block.timestamp, msg.sender and inp modulo 1e20
setBaseURI(string baseURI_) onlyOwner: overrides _baseURIextended
updateCodeHash(string _newhash) onlyOwner: overwrites generationCodeHash
uploadCode(uint part, string code) onlyOwner: writes on-chain generation code part
checkCDB(uint cdbID) view: validates the CryptoDickbutt token via external ownerOf and returns whether unused
getNextTokenID() internal view: sum of counter_mints and counter_cdbs
pause() onlyOwner: triggers Pausable stopped state (contract starts paused)
constructor: ERC721('Dickenzas','DKNZA'), binds cdb to addr_cdb, pauses contract
_checkOnERC721Received private: calls onERC721Received on recipient contract during safe mint/transfer
msg.sender: caller used for ownership checks, mint recipient and fund withdrawal
block.timestamp: miner-influenceable time source fed into generateHash
payable(msg.sender).transfer(address(this).balance) raw value transfer in withdraw()
External call cdb.ownerOf(cdbID) on the untrusted ICryptoDickbutts contract
_safeMint external callback into recipient contract (onERC721Received), reentrancy vector
Counters.increment / unchecked counter._value += 1 arithmetic affecting mint accounting
Hash derived from block.timestamp/block.difficulty: predictable, miner-influenceable randomness
cdbID parameter of mintWithCDB and checkCDB, user-supplied NFT id
new_price parameter of adjustPrice
baseURI_ parameter of setBaseURI
inp parameter of generateHash, the token id being hashed
part parameter of uploadCode selecting the on-chain code chunk
code parameter of uploadCode holding the javascript payload
nextTokenId local computed from getNextTokenID inside mint paths
hash local returned by generateHash and stored in tokenHash
i loop counter in reserveMints

edges.reason: User-supplied cdbID flows into mintWithCDB free-mint logic
cdbID is validated by checkCDB
mintWithCDB authorizes the caller by requiring cdb.ownerOf(cdbID) == msg.sender
mint mints the new token directly to msg.sender
withdraw sends the entire balance to msg.sender gated only by onlyOwner
msg.sender is mixed into the generated hash
block.timestamp is used as randomness input, timestamp dependency
inp parameter feeds the keccak hash computation
generateHash produces miner-influenceable pseudo-random output
generateHash result is returned into the hash local variable
hash is stored and emitted in mintWithCDB
hash is stored and emitted in mint
hash is generated and stored per reserved token
mintWithCDB writes tokenHash[nextTokenId]
mint writes tokenHash[nextTokenId]
reserveMints writes tokenHash[nextTokenId]
mint enforces msg.value >= mintPrice
new_price parameter is assigned to the price state
adjustPrice overwrites mintPrice
mint checks the MAX_MINTS supply cap
mintWithCDB checks the MAX_MINTS supply cap
mintWithCDB checks the MAX_CDB_MINTS free-mint cap
mintWithCDB reads cdb_mint to prevent double claiming
checkCDB reads cdb_mint to report unused ids
mintWithCDB sets cdb_mint[cdbID] = true before minting
getNextTokenID reads counter_mints.current()
getNextTokenID reads counter_cdbs.current()
getNextTokenID result is stored in nextTokenId
nextTokenId is minted in mint
nextTokenId is minted in mintWithCDB
nextTokenId is minted inside the reserveMints loop
mint calls getNextTokenID
mintWithCDB calls getNextTokenID
reserveMints calls getNextTokenID each iteration
mint performs _safeMint which re-enters the recipient contract via onERC721Received
mintWithCDB performs _safeMint triggering a recipient callback
reserveMints performs _safeMint in a loop, each triggering a recipient callback
_safeMint routes into _checkOnERC721Received which invokes the receiver
_checkOnERC721Received forwards _msgSender() as the operator argument to onERC721Received
checkCDB performs an external call to cdb.ownerOf
mintWithCDB performs an external call to cdb.ownerOf inside requires/checkCDB
withdraw performs a raw value transfer to msg.sender
mint mutates the unchecked Counters counter for paid mints
mintWithCDB mutates the unchecked Counters counter for free mints
reserveMints increments the paid-mint counter ten times
mint increments counter_mints affecting supply accounting
mintWithCDB increments counter_cdbs affecting free-mint accounting
reserveMints increments counter_mints
baseURI_ parameter is assigned in setBaseURI
setBaseURI overwrites _baseURIextended
part parameter indexes generationCode in uploadCode
code parameter is the payload written by uploadCode
uploadCode writes into the on-chain generationCode mapping
updateCodeHash overwrites generationCodeHash
i is the loop bound controlling reserveMints iterations
pause sets _paused through _pause
constructor calls _pause putting the contract in stopped state
constructor binds cdb to the ICryptoDickbutts at addr_cdb

normalization_plan.reason: cdbID is only meaningful as the user-supplied identifier consumed by the free-mint function; collapse it into mintWithCDB
new_price is a transient argument whose only effect is writing mintPrice inside adjustPrice
baseURI_ is a transient argument assigned to _baseURIextended inside setBaseURI
inp is the hashed token id passed into the internal hash generator
part is only used to index the generationCode mapping inside uploadCode
code is the payload stored by uploadCode and has no independent semantics
nextTokenId is an internal mint index derived from getNextTokenID and consumed immediately by the mint flow
hash only carries the generateHash return value into tokenHash and the Mint event
i is the loop induction variable bounded entirely within reserveMints
